integrity: Analytic all-dimensional proof plus independently executable finite exact checks; finite computations are not the proof of universal lower bounds or complete threshold enumeration.
limitations: Full-dimensional parallelotopes; interior hyperplane cuts; minimal degree in the volume variable of a global real polynomial relation, not total degree, coefficient bounds, or irreducible minimal polynomial. Established Boolean counts are credited; no independent priority check.
title: Threshold functions determine the exact algebraic degree of parallelotope cutoff volumes
